About BookFunnel

BookFunnel is an ebook delivery service! We want you to get your book as quickly and as painlessly as possible.

Our clients are our authors, and we love them just as much as you do. BookFunnel.com will not start emailing you books or other free offers— we don’t even have a reader mailing list! We are here solely to help you get their free book downloaded so that you can curl up with it and start reading ASAP.

How does this work?

BookFunnel provides step-by-step instructions to download your book so that you can start reading ASAP.

Depending on your device, that may take a couple of clicks, or it may take… a bit more than that! We deliver thousands of books every hour, to readers all over the world.

Click through the instructions for your device and give it a shot. If you get stuck in the middle, no problem. Just click the Need Help? at the top of the book page to let a member of our support staff know you are having trouble.

Kindle

With Amazon's Send to Kindle, you can add this book to your Kindle library and enjoy reading on any Kindle app or device!

  • Send to Kindle
    1. Install the BookFunnel app Get the BookFunnel App
    2. Tap this code
      CODETWO
    3. Tap Send to Kindle
    4. Share your ebook with the Kindle app
    5. Tap Send to Kindle
    1. Install the BookFunnel app from your device's app store (supported on iOS 11+ and Android 5.1+)
    2. Enter this code
      CODETWO
    Having trouble?
    Add a comment
    1. Download the Kindle EPUB file Download Kindle File
    2. Go to https://amazon.de/sendtokindle
    3. Log into your Amazon account if you haven't already
    4. Once you are logged into your Amazon account, click or tap the big, yellow Select files from device button on the Amazon Send to Kindle page.
    5. Find your Downloads folder on your device and select the ebook you just downloaded to upload to Amazon. You can select multiple ebooks at once if you like.
    6. Once you've selected the ebooks you want to Send to Kindle, click or tap the big, yellow Send button.
    7. The upload will start, and you should see the status of your book(s) near the bottom of the page. Once Amazon says the status is in library, you're all set! Your new books will appear in the Kindle library on all of your Kindle apps and devices.
    Having trouble?

  • Read on your Kobo E-reader
    1. Tap the More button from your Kobo's home screen
    2. Tap Beta Features from the More screen
    3. Tap Start under WEB BROWSER

    4. Tap the address box at the top (not the Google search box) and type this link

      BookHip.com/CODETWO
      (you can type it all lowercase)
    5. When the page loads, tap the book cover to download your book
    6. The book should appear on your Kobo's Home screen

Download Talons and Treason - After Dark

Download

Finn was given a choice between his oath and the man beneath the scales. He didn't hesitate.

Now they're deep in enemy territory, following the patchy memory of a druid who spent the last few centuries as a goat—toward Ascendant's Rest, the ancient rite he swears will set the dragon right. Not a curse, he insists. A blessing, half-finished. Cedric has spent years certain he deserved his scales; he doesn't know what to do with the idea that they might be a gift.

Finn does. He's loved him in both shapes. He's just waiting for Cedric to catch up.

The crown calls what they have treason. Finn would commit it again tomorrow.
